key_insight: DiagTrace evaluates how LLMs seek information to reconstruct documented diagnostic trajectories, rather than judging only their final diagnoses.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark tests incremental evidence gathering, an aspect of diagnostic reasoning missed when all patient information is provided upfront.
method: Build source-grounded cases from PubMed Central case reports.
Provide an initial presentation, event bank, clinical course, and diagnostic references.
Evaluate interactive information seeking for clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency.
evidence_signal: DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties; evaluation of four LLMs on 225 cases revealed trade-offs in coverage, source-consistent ordering, and turn use.
watch_item: Alignment with published case-report trajectories does not establish diagnostic safety or effectiveness in real-world patient care.
paper_title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
